{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
filtered_data = data[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Stratify by customer_segment to compute conversion rate by channel within each segment
results = []
for segment in filtered_data['customer_segment'].unique():
    subset = filtered_data[filtered_data['customer_segment'] == segment]
    conv_rate_email = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    conv_rate_paid_search = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    avg_rev_email = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].mean()
    avg_rev_paid_search = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].mean()
    
    results.append({
        'customer_segment': segment,
        'email_conversion': conv_rate_email,
        'paid_search_conversion': conv_rate_paid_search,
        'email_revenue': avg_rev_email,
        'paid_search_revenue': avg_rev_paid_search,
        'conversion_diff': conv_rate_email - conv_rate_paid_search,
        'revenue_diff': avg_rev_email - avg_rev_paid_search
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
stratified_results = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(stratified_results)

# Compute the average difference in conversion and revenue across segments
avg_conv_diff = stratified_results['conversion_diff'].mean()
avg_rev_diff = stratified_results['revenue_diff'].mean()

print(f"Average conversion difference (email - paid_search): {avg_conv_diff}")
print(f"Average revenue difference (email - paid_search): {avg_rev_diff}")

# Also print the raw conversion rates and revenue for email and paid_search across all segments
overall_conv_email = filtered_data[filtered_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
overall_conv_paid_search = filtered_data[filtered_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
overall_rev_email = filtered_data[filtered_data['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].mean()
overall_rev_paid_search = filtered_data[filtered_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Overall email conversion rate: {overall_conv_email}")
print(f"Overall paid_search conversion rate: {overall_conv_paid_search}")
print(f"Overall email average revenue: {overall_rev_email}")
print(f"Overall paid_search average revenue: {overall_rev_paid_search}")"}
